summary: Frontend E2E of the RibhShare first-time sign-in flow (FLOW 1..4). data-testid fix is confirmed working (all 6 test IDs on /first-signin and /sign-in are now visible in the DOM). FLOWS 1 and 4 (invalid code + re-redemption) PASS with correct inline error copy. FLOWS 2 and 3 FAIL because of an AuthGuard race in /app/app/_layout.tsx: after verifyMagicToken succeeds, the app never reaches /set-password — the router is force-redirected to /home before SetPasswordScreen can mount, so the password is never set and subsequent /sign-in with that password fails (400 Invalid login credentials).

integration_issues.issue: After redeem-invite-code + verifyOtp succeed, FirstSigninScreen calls router.replace('/set-password?projectId=...'), but the top-level AuthGuard (app/_layout.tsx lines 27-29) sees `session && inAuthGroup` and immediately calls router.replace(getDefaultTabRoute(role)), sending the user to /home. The /set-password screen never renders, so passwordAlreadySet is never flipped and no auth password is stored. Verified via direct probe: /functions/v1/redeem-invite-code returns passwordAlreadySet: false correctly, so the bug is 100% client-side routing.

integration_issues.flow: Sign in with newly set password (FLOW 3)
integration_issues.issue: Downstream failure of the AuthGuard bug above: because Flow 2 never sets a password, POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password returns 400 Invalid login credentials and the user stays on /sign-in. Will be resolved automatically once Flow 2 is fixed.

action_items: Fix AuthGuard in /app/app/_layout.tsx so that a signed-in user is allowed to remain on /set-password (and only /set-password) inside the (auth) group. Suggested guard: `if (session && inAuthGroup && segments[1] !== 'set-password') router.replace(getDefaultTabRoute(role))`. Alternatively, expose a `mustSetPassword` flag in useAuthStore that FirstSigninScreen sets before verifyMagicToken, and short-circuit the AuthGuard while that flag is true.

After fix: also confirm the redirect target on successful set-password. The current SetPasswordScreen likely navigates to /(tabs)/projects/eb8ef102-... — verify that route resolves for a fresh investor whose role has just been loaded.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthGuard in app/_layout.tsx unconditionally kicks any session-holding user out of the (auth) group. This is incompatible with the invite-code flow, which intentionally signs the user in (via verifyOtp) BEFORE routing them to /set-password. The guard needs an exception for /set-password when the user has not yet set a password.

FirstSigninScreen router.replace('/set-password?...') is racing against the AuthGuard useEffect. Even if the guard is fixed, consider awaiting a microtask or using expo-router's `router.push` with a hard state change, so the intent survives auth-state re-renders.
redeem-invite-code edge function response is clean and returns passwordAlreadySet correctly — no backend fix needed.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (2 of 4 flows: FLOW 1 invalid-code ✅, FLOW 2 happy-path ❌, FLOW 3 sign-in with set password ❌, FLOW 4 re-redemption blocked ✅)
